prompts.prompt: Create 16-bit pixel art for a retro Futbol Island story game. Reference image defines aesthetic: authentic SNES-era pixel sprites, chunky pixel outlines, limited palette, deliberate dithering, pixel island landscape. No smooth 3D, no sticker outlines. Cast retain charcoal kits, hair identities and numbers. FORMAT exactly 3 equal wide panels stacked, 1024x1536 total; each 1024x512. Pixel grid consistent across characters and scenery. Whole characters within generous margins. No UI, speech, captions or text except jersey numbers and specified scoreboard. Each panel is one still moment for tap-through gameplay. Cast: Luna, the central brown-haired high ponytail girl number10 in reference, and Kai, curly dark-haired boy in reference. Warm afternoon near island goal. TOP: Luna has just missed a chance, shoulders lowered, ball wide of goal; Kai nearby giving space. MIDDLE: Luna takes a breath and looks back toward play, upright ready to offer support, ball stays wide. BOTTOM: Kai stands beside Luna giving a gentle encouraging cue; Luna listens and looks toward play. Emotion subtle, supportive and credible. Luna must retain reference ponytail, brown eyes and charcoal kit.
